programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc:
Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt
The next stop on Pascal Brodnicki's culinary journey is Laos, whose cuisine is famous for its unusual ingredients.Flowers, insects, frogs, tadpoles, insect cocoons, lizards, geckos and even squirrel meat are eaten here.Fried seaweed, khai pene, is the culinary trademark of Luang Prabang, a city located in the north of the country.In Laos, hundreds of families earn their living by harvesting seaweed.The traveling chef found out what their job is all about.For several hours he collected algae from the bottom of the Mekong, then cut them and rolled them into long sheets.

programs.title: Taste the world with Pascal
programs.desc:
Master chef Pascal Brodnicki shows viewers how to replace traditional dishes with Asian dishes.It proves that preparing an original dinner is simple and does not have to cost much.In search of culinary inspiration, he goes to Vietnam, Laos and Thailand.He shops at local markets, prepares and sells snacks on the street, and works on a rice plantation.To prove himself, he prepares exotic dishes for his Asian hosts.He tries grilled gecko and baked ant larvae, and accepts an invitation to an unusual hunt
A traveling chef learns about the peculiarities of southern Vietnam.Hanoi is a place where different cultures meet.The restaurants serve delicacies known all over the world, such as egg omelette.Seafood is popular, including huge snails weighing several kilograms.The main export of this part of Vietnam is ngoc mam fish sauce.Pascal Brodnicki will have the opportunity to present his culinary skills in difficult conditions.At a street eatery in Saigon, he will prepare three dishes in five minutes.
